name: Umeå University
summary: Research university in Umeå, northern Sweden; four programmes taught in English: industrial design, life science, business and architecture.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: International round closes (Industrial Design, Life Science, Business and Economics)
International round: documents and proof of EU/EEA citizenship due
Second round opens (EU/EEA/Swiss citizens; the round for Architecture)
Second round: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
Final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
Second round: reply to your offer or lose the place

programmes.name: Bachelor Programme in Industrial Design
programmes.ib: IB grades do not rank you: work samples and a motivation letter (due 1 Feb 2027), then an interview in Umeå for 20–30 shortlisted. About 15 places.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science Programme in Life Science
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry at grade 4 (3 at HL), plus Maths AI SL at 4, AA SL at 3, or AA/AI HL at 3.

programmes.name: International Business and Economics Programme
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business and Economics
programmes.ib: Maths AI SL at 4, AA SL at 3, or AA/AI HL at 3. Ranked on grades.

programmes.name: Architecture Programme
programmes.ib: Maths as for Business, plus ESS SL or two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics. Up to a third of places by the Arkitektprovet test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Architecture is open only in the second round (15 March–15 April 2027); the other three are published only in the January round so far.
University Admissions recommends that IB students still in their final year apply in the second round, so ask Umeå whether a January application can wait for your final IB results.
Industrial Design lets you prove general entry later, by the second-round document deadline, but its work samples are due on 1 February 2027.
